title: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) Classical Monograph
content: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera / Indian Ginseng) is a revered Balya and Rasayana herb in Ayurveda. Traditional uses: Pacifies Vata and Kapha doshas, promotes Dhatu nourishment, reduces Manasika Shrama (mental stress) and supports sound sleep. Standard extract dose: 300mg to 600mg standardized withanolides. Precautions: Avoid during pregnancy; use caution with immunosuppressants.

title: Triphala Churna Classical Monograph
content: Triphala is an equal-part formulation of Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), and Amalaki (Phyllanthus emblica). Traditional indications: Deepana-Pachana (digestive stimulation), Anulomana (mild bowel regulation), and Rasayana detox. Dosage: 3-5g with warm water at bedtime.
